pointers.Original Text: 放課後、いつものようにホスト部で接客をする。
pointers.New Text:
I'll serve customers at the Host
Club as usual after school.
pointers.MT Text:
I'll serve customers at the Host
Club as usual after school.

pointers.Original Text: いつもと変わらない、そう思っていたのだけれど……。
pointers.New Text:
I thought it would be just like
always...
pointers.MT Text:
I thought it would be just the same
as always...

pointers.Original Text: 「姫の眩い微笑み……。その微笑の前では夜の帳（とばり）も恥らって顔を出さぬというものです……」
pointers.New Text:
Princess's dazzling smile...
Night shies away, hiding...
pointers.MT Text:
Princess's dazzling smile...
Night shies away, hiding...

pointers.Original Text: 「ああ、ハルヒ。庶民コーヒーの予備が切れたので補充を頼む」
pointers.New Text:
Yeah, Haruhi. I need you to
restock the plain coffee; we're
out.
pointers.MT Text:
Oh, Haruhi. I ran out of the backup
coffee for the commoners, so could
you restock it?

pointers.Original Text: 「馨ったら昨日、課題のノートを忘れてさ」
pointers.New Text:
Kaoru forgot his homework
notebook yesterday.
pointers.MT Text:
Kaoru forgot to bring his homework
notebook yesterday.

pointers.Original Text: 「あー！　それは言わない約束だろう、光！」
pointers.New Text:
Hey! We promised not to say
that, Hikaru!
pointers.MT Text:
Oh! We made a promise not to say
that, Hikaru!

pointers.Original Text: 「ごめん、ごめん。慌てた顔の馨が可愛かったからつい……」
pointers.New Text:
Sorry, sorry. I couldn't help
myself because Kaoru looked so
cute when he was flustered.
pointers.MT Text:
Sorry, sorry. I couldn't help
myself because Kaoru looked so
cute when he was flustered.

pointers.Original Text: 「？　ハニー先輩、先ほどからフォークをかじっていますけどもしかしておかわりが欲しいんですか？」
pointers.New Text:
Honey-senpai, you've been
chewing on your fork. Do you
want more?
pointers.MT Text:
? Honey-senpai, you've been chewing
on your fork for a while now. Do you
want another serving?

pointers.Original Text: 「ん、ハルちゃん。んーとね、えっとね。おかわり……うん、欲しいかな」
pointers.New Text:
Hmm, Haru-chan. Well, um... do
you want seconds?
pointers.MT Text:
"*Hmm, Haru-chan. Well, umm...
seconds... yeah, I want some."*

pointers.Original Text: こ、この２人は流石というかなんというか……。
pointers.MT Text:
T-These two are truly something
else...

pointers.Original Text: いつの間におかわりを用意していたとか、聞いてもしかたないんだろうなぁ……。
pointers.New Text:
I guess it's no use asking when
you prepared seconds...
pointers.MT Text:
I guess it's pointless to ask when
you managed to prepare a refill...

pointers.Original Text: 「光邦。気になることがあるのなら口に出すべきだ」
pointers.New Text:
Haruhi. If something's on your
mind, you should say it.
pointers.MT Text:
Hikuma, if something's bothering
you, you should just say it.

pointers.Original Text: 「ハニー先輩、何か気になることでもあるんですか？」
pointers.New Text:
Senior Honey, is there something
on your mind?
pointers.MT Text:
Senior Honey, is there something
on your mind?

pointers.Original Text: 「ぬうっ、ハニー先輩の悩みは我らが悩み！そうだろう、諸君」
pointers.New Text:
Aww, Honey-senpai's worries are
our worries! Right, everyone?
pointers.MT Text:
Ugh, Honya-senpai's worries are our
worries! Right, everyone?

pointers.Original Text: 「あー、また殿の病気がはじまったよ」
pointers.New Text:
Oh, His Lordship's illness has
started again.
pointers.MT Text:
Oh, His Lordship's illness has
started again.

pointers.Original Text: 「悩み相談とか大好きだもんね～殿は」
pointers.New Text:
I love giving advice~ My
princess.
pointers.MT Text:
Aren't you just loving this little
therapy session, Your Lordship?

pointers.Original Text: 「ハルちゃん、タマちゃん、心配してくれてありがとう。だけどね、これは僕自身の問題だからみんなに迷惑かけたくないんだ」
pointers.New Text:
Haru-chan, Tama-chan, thanks,
but this is my problem.
pointers.MT Text:
Haru-chan, Tama-chan, thanks,
but this is my problem.

pointers.Original Text: 「崇も心配しなくて大丈夫だよ。僕１人で解決できちゃう問題だもん。えへへ～」
pointers.New Text:
Don't worry, Takashi. I can
handle this all by myself.
Hehehe~
pointers.MT Text:
Don't worry about me, Honoka. I can
handle this all by myself. Hehe~

pointers.Original Text: （１人で解決できちゃう問題だったらあからさまに溜息なんてつかないよね）
pointers.New Text:
(I wouldn't sigh so obviously if
I could solve it on my own.)
pointers.MT Text:
(I wouldn't sigh so obviously if
I could solve it on my own.)

pointers.Original Text: （そうそう。殿みたいに端っこでいじけられるのと大差ない反応だよね）
pointers.New Text:
(Just like being ignored by some
prince. It's pretty much the
same reaction.)
pointers.MT Text:
(That's right. It's pretty much the
same reaction as getting ignored and
moping around like you do.)

pointers.Original Text: （ちょっ。２人ともこそこそ話にしては声が大きすぎです。ハニー先輩に内容が筒抜けですよ！）
pointers.New Text:
Heh. Too loud for secrets!
Honey'll hear every word!
pointers.MT Text:
Heh. Too loud for secrets!
Honey'll hear every word!

pointers.Original Text: （だって聞かせてるんだもーん）
「ハニー先輩の売りはケーキをむさぼり食い、かつ３年とは思えないロリショタ顔。それに加えた邪気のない笑顔だ」
pointers.New Text:
Honey-senpai's charms are cake,
a youthful face, and an innocent
smile.
pointers.MT Text:
Honey-senpai's charms are cake,
a youthful face, and an innocent
smile.

pointers.Original Text: 「沈んだ顔でケーキを食べている姿は、お客様に不安感を抱かせることにはなりませんか？」
pointers.New Text:
Doesn't eating cake with a
downcast face make customers
feel uneasy?
pointers.MT Text:
Doesn't eating cake with a downcast
face give customers an uneasy
feeling?

pointers.Original Text: （鏡夜先輩の笑みってはたから見れば邪気がなさそーだけど、絶対零度の微笑みっていうのかな）
pointers.New Text:
Kyoya-senpai smiles innocently,
but it's cold as ice.
pointers.MT Text:
Kyoya-senpai smiles innocently,
but it's cold as ice.

pointers.Original Text: （背筋がぞくぞくする類の笑みだよね。説得に近いおどしだよ、これ）
pointers.New Text:
(It's a creepy smile that's
almost like a threat disguised
as persuasion.)
pointers.MT Text:
It's a smile that chills
you, almost like a threat
wrapped in persuasion.

pointers.Original Text: 「みんな心配している。内に溜め込んでいても何の解決にもならない」
pointers.New Text:
Everyone's worried about you.
Keeping things bottled up won't
solve anything.
pointers.MT Text:
Everyone's worried about you.
Keeping it bottled up won't solve
anything.

pointers.Original Text: 「そうです！　我らは仲間ではありませんか！ここはひとつこの須王環率いる桜蘭レンジャーに任せてみてはいかがでしょう？」
pointers.New Text:
That's right! Aren't we
comrades? How about the Ouran
Rangers, led by me, Tamaki?
pointers.MT Text:
That's right! Aren't we
comrades? How about the Ouran
Rangers, led by me, Tamaki?

pointers.Original Text: 「殿のことだから子供向け番組の戦隊ものでも見たんでしょ」
pointers.New Text:
You probably watched some kids'
show with superheroes.
pointers.MT Text:
You probably watched some kiddie
show with a superhero team, didn't
you?

pointers.Original Text: 「殿は影響受けやすいからねー」
「桜蘭レンジャーとかはどうでもいいですけど、悩みがあるなら相談に乗りますよ？」
pointers.New Text:
Whatever about those Ouran
Rangers, if you've got problems,
I'll listen.
pointers.MT Text:
Whatever about those Ouran
Rangers, if you've got problems,
I'll listen.

pointers.Original Text: 「わあああん！！　鏡夜～ハルヒが冷たいよー！」
pointers.New Text:
Aaaah!! Kyoya~ Haruhi's being
mean to me!
pointers.MT Text:
Awaaaah!! Haruhiiiii~ You're being
mean to meee!

pointers.Original Text: 「今に始まったことではないだろう。で、営業にも差支えがあるのでハニー先輩の悩みとやらを聞かせて頂けますか？」
pointers.New Text:
This isn't the first time, and
sales are affected. What's
Honey's problem?
pointers.MT Text:
This isn't the first time, and
sales are affected. What's
Honey's problem?

pointers.New Text:
Cake shop in front of the
station...?
pointers.MT Text:
Are you talking about the cake shop
near the station?

pointers.Original Text: 「あー、最近駅前に出来たケーキ屋でしょ？」
pointers.New Text:
Ah, it's that new cake shop near
the station, right?
pointers.MT Text:
Oh, you mean that new cake shop near
the station?

pointers.Original Text: 「フランス帰りの有名パティシエが運営してるっていう」
pointers.New Text:
A famous pastry chef who just
returned from France runs it.
pointers.MT Text:
A famous pastry chef who just
returned from France runs it.

pointers.Original Text: 「へー、そんなのができてたんだ。知らなかったよ」
pointers.New Text:
Hey, so you could do that. I
didn't know.
pointers.MT Text:
Wow, so that's what it was. I had no
idea.

pointers.Original Text: 「ハルヒは周りにムトンチャクだからね～」
pointers.New Text:
You're such a sheep in wolf's
clothing~
pointers.MT Text:
Haruhi's got a bunch of sheep around
her, you know?

pointers.Original Text: 「して、ハニー先輩はそのケーキ屋さんにどのようなお悩みがあるのでしょう？」
pointers.New Text:
So, Senior Honey, what's your
problem with that cake shop?
pointers.MT Text:
So, Senior Honey, what's your
problem with that cake shop?

pointers.Original Text: 「そこのお店のケーキね。すっごく美味しいんだって」
pointers.New Text:
That cake at that shop over
there. It's supposed to be
really delicious.
pointers.MT Text:
That cake from that shop over there
is supposed to be super delicious.

pointers.Original Text: 「その中で見た目も可愛くて食べちゃうのがもったいないくらいのケーキがあるって聞いて、お店に行ってきたんだ」
pointers.New Text:
I heard there was a cake so cute
you'd feel bad eating it, so I
went to check it out.
pointers.MT Text:
I heard there was a cake so cute
you'd feel bad eating it, so I
went to check it out.

pointers.Original Text: 「そうしたら……そのケーキがね。僕の大嫌いな人参さんでね」
pointers.New Text:
That's when... that cake was
made of carrots, which I hate.
pointers.MT Text:
That's when... that cake was
made of carrots, which I hate.

pointers.Original Text: 「甘さを控えたキャロットケーキなんだって。食べたかったけど、僕……人参さんだけは駄目なんだよ～」
pointers.New Text:
It's carrot cake with less
sugar. Wanted some... but no
carrots for me~
pointers.MT Text:
It's carrot cake with less
sugar. Wanted some... but no
carrots for me~

pointers.Original Text: 「ええ！　ハニー先輩って人参が嫌いだったんですか！」
pointers.New Text:
Really!? You don't like carrots,
Honey-senpai!?

pointers.Original Text: うさぎのぬいぐるみを大事に抱えている印象が強い所為か、はたまたハニー先輩がうさぎっぽいからか……。
pointers.New Text:
Maybe it's the bunny doll, or
maybe Honey-senpai is bunny-like
himself...
pointers.MT Text:
Maybe it's the bunny doll, or
maybe Honey-senpai is bunny-like
himself...

pointers.Original Text: 野菜は苦手そうだなぁとは思っていたけれど、先入観で人参だけは大丈夫じゃないかって思ってた。
pointers.New Text:
I thought you didn't like
vegetables, but I figured
carrots were an exception.
pointers.MT Text:
I thought you didn't like
vegetables, but I figured
carrots were an exception.

pointers.Original Text: 自覚したくないけれど、ここの雰囲気に慣れてきてたってことなのかなぁ……。
pointers.New Text:
I don't want to admit it, but
maybe I've gotten used to the
atmosphere here...?
pointers.MT Text:
I don't want to admit it, but
maybe I've gotten used to the
atmosphere here...?

pointers.Original Text: 「見てのとおり甘いものが大好きなハニー先輩は野菜があまり好きではない。その中でも特に嫌いなのが……人参だ」
pointers.New Text:
Sweet-loving Honey-senpai
dislikes vegetables, especially
carrots.
pointers.MT Text:
Sweet-loving Honey-senpai
dislikes vegetables, especially
carrots.

pointers.Original Text: 「うーでも他の野菜さんは食べられるもん」
pointers.New Text:
Yeah, but other veggies can eat
it.
pointers.MT Text: Ugh, but I can eat other veggies.

pointers.Original Text: 「ハニー先輩はウサギっぽいから無条件で人参は大丈夫だと思っていたが、ぬう。須王環一生の不覚！」
pointers.New Text:
I thought Honey-senpai was bunny
enough to eat carrots. Tamaki's
mistake!
pointers.MT Text:
I thought Honey-senpai was bunny
enough to eat carrots. Tamaki's
mistake!

pointers.Original Text: （うわぁ、環先輩と同じ考えってなんだか嫌だなぁ……）
pointers.New Text:
(Man, I don't like it when I
think the same as Tama-chan...)
pointers.MT Text:
(Man, I don't like it when I
think the same as Tama-chan...)

pointers.Original Text: 「しかし、それでも食べたいのだろう？」
pointers.New Text:
But you still want to eat it,
don't you?
pointers.MT Text: But you still want to eat it, right?

pointers.Original Text: 「うん……だけど人参さんだけはどうしても食べられないからさ、僕あきらめることにしたんだ」
pointers.New Text:
Yeah... but I just can't eat
carrots, so I gave up.
pointers.MT Text:
Yeah... but I just can't eat
carrots, so I gave up.

pointers.Original Text: 「みんな、ほんとうにごめんね。ほら、ケーキならこーんなにいっぱいあるもん。僕、幸せだよ」
pointers.New Text:
I'm really sorry everyone. Look,
there are so many cakes here. I
feel happy.
pointers.MT Text:
Sorry guys, really. Look, there's so
much cake here. I'm happy.

pointers.Original Text: なんだろう……。さほど重要な話でもないのに、ハニー先輩の笑顔にいじらしさを感じるっていうか。
pointers.New Text:
I wonder... Even though it's not
a big deal, I feel touched by
Honey-senpai's smile.
pointers.MT Text:
I wonder... Even though it's not
a big deal, I feel touched by
Honey-senpai's smile.

pointers.Original Text: ああ、ハニー先輩にとってケーキは死活問題だから無理をして笑った顔がはかなげに見えるのかな。
pointers.New Text:
Ah, maybe that's because
Honey-senpai forced a smile when
he was worried about the cake.
pointers.MT Text:
Ah, maybe that's because
Honey-senpai forced a smile when
he was worried about the cake.

pointers.Original Text: 「僕は大丈夫だもん。タマちゃんもカオちゃんもヒカちゃんも、ハルちゃんも鏡ちゃんもお客様待たせちゃ駄目でしょ？　ね？」
pointers.New Text:
I'm fine. Tama-chan, Kao, Hika,
Haru, and Kyouya can't keep
guests waiting.
pointers.MT Text:
I'm fine. Tama-chan, Kao, Hika,
Haru, and Kyouya can't keep
guests waiting.

pointers.Original Text: 「うーん、このケーキすっごく美味しい。崇、おかわり！」
pointers.New Text:
Hmm, this cake is super
delicious! Takashi, seconds!
pointers.MT Text:
Hmm, this cake is super delicious.
Sou, seconds!

pointers.Original Text: （してるしてる。おかわりとか言いつつ、フォーク差し出してるよ）
pointers.New Text:
(Am I not? Am I not? While
saying things like "seconds,"
I'm holding out my fork.)
pointers.MT Text:
(Am I not? Am I not? While
saying things like "seconds,"
I'm holding out my fork.)

pointers.Original Text: （あれはかなり気にしてるよね～）
「……それじゃあ自分は買出しに行ってきます。ハニー先輩、無理しないで下さいね」
pointers.New Text:
I'm going shopping.
Honey-senpai, don't overdo it.
pointers.MT Text:
...Then I'll go shopping.
Honey-senpai, don't overdo it,
okay?

pointers.Original Text: 「ありがとう。ハルちゃんもお買い物、気をつけて行ってきてね」
pointers.New Text:
Thanks. Be careful on your
shopping trip too, Haru-chan.
pointers.MT Text:
Thanks. Be careful when you go
shopping too, Haru.

pointers.Original Text: （このまま話を流して良いのか、鏡夜！）
pointers.New Text:
(Should I just let this slide,
Kyoya?)
pointers.MT Text:
(Should I just let this slide,
Kyoya?)

pointers.Original Text: （ハニー先輩がああ言っているんだ。ここは一旦接客に戻った方が良いだろう）
pointers.New Text:
(Honey-senpai said that. I
should probably go back to
attending customers.)
pointers.MT Text:
(Honey-senpai said so, so we should
probably get back to work)

pointers.Original Text: 「じゃあ僕たちはお姫の相手でもしてきまーす」
pointers.New Text:
Then we'll go entertain my
princess~
pointers.MT Text:
Then we'll go entertain the princess
for a while.

pointers.Original Text: 「……俺は備品のチェックでもするとしよう。環、お前はこちらの姫から指名が入っている。速やかにお席にお通ししてくれ」
pointers.New Text:
I'll check the equipment.
Tamaki, escort our guest. Show
her to an empty seat.
pointers.MT Text:
I'll check the equipment.
Tamaki, escort our guest. Show
her to an empty seat.

pointers.Original Text: 「ハニーくん、なんだかお元気がないみたいだけれど……」
pointers.New Text:
Honey-kun, you seem a bit
down...
pointers.MT Text:
Honey-kun, you seem a bit
down...

pointers.Original Text: 「う、ううん！　ちょっとだけ考えごとしてたんだ。ごめんね」
pointers.New Text:
U-Um! I was just thinking to
myself. Sorry.
pointers.MT Text:
U-uh! I was just thinking for a
moment there. Sorry.

pointers.Original Text: 「そうでしたの。どのようなことをお考え遊ばしていたのかお伺いしてもよろしいかしら？」
pointers.New Text:
Is it all right if I ask what
you were thinking about?
pointers.MT Text:
Is it all right if I ask what
you were thinking about?

pointers.Original Text: 「えーっとね、今日のケーキはイチゴがのったショートケーキだけど明日はチョコケーキにしようかなぁって」
pointers.New Text:
Um, today's cake is strawberry
shortcake, but maybe I'll have
chocolate cake tomorrow.
pointers.MT Text:
Um, today's cake is strawberry
shortcake, but maybe I'll have
chocolate cake tomorrow.

pointers.Original Text: 「うさちゃんは何味のケーキが好きかなぁ？」
pointers.New Text:
What flavor of cake do you like,
Usachan?
pointers.MT Text:
Hey, what kind of cake do you like,
Usachan?

pointers.Original Text: （いじらしい！　涙を耐え忍ぶ姿にどうにかしてあげたいという気持ちが芽生えないか、諸君！）
pointers.New Text:
(Poor thing! Can't you feel a
desire to help her hold back her
tears somehow, everyone!)
pointers.MT Text:
(How adorable! Can't you guys feel
the urge to do something about her
holding back tears?)

pointers.Original Text: （環先輩、顔が近いです。確かに気になりますが、涙は耐え忍んでないと思います）
pointers.New Text:
(Tamaki-senpai, your face is
close. While it's tempting, I
don't think I'll cry.)
pointers.MT Text:
(Tamaki-senpai, your face is
close. While it's tempting, I
don't think I'll cry.)

pointers.Original Text: （ハルヒ～お父さんはお前をそのような子に育てた覚えはありませんよ！）
pointers.New Text:
(Haruhi--I don't remember
raising you to be like that!)
pointers.MT Text:
(Haruhi~! Dad never raised you to be
such a brat!)

pointers.Original Text: （育てられた覚えは一切ありません）
pointers.New Text:
(I don't remember being raised
by you.)

pointers.Original Text: （うわあああん！　お母さん、ハルヒが反抗期だよ～）
pointers.New Text:
(Oh no! Mom, Haruhi's in her
rebellious phase~)
pointers.MT Text:
(Ahhh! Mom, Haruhi's in her
rebellious phase~)

pointers.Original Text: （ああ、わかった。わかった。とにかくあの状態のハニー先輩を気にしながらでは接客に多大な影響を及ぼすことになる）
pointers.New Text:
(I see. If I worry about
Honey-senpai like this, it'll
affect my service.)
pointers.MT Text:
(I see. If I worry about
Honey-senpai like this, it'll
affect my service.)

pointers.Original Text: （題して、ハニー先輩の人参克服大作戦☆決行）
（面白おかしく騒ごうって寸法さ）
pointers.MT Text: (Let's make a big fuss for fun.)

pointers.Original Text: （せめて最後は隠すとかしなよ）
pointers.New Text:
(At least don't hide at the
end.)
pointers.MT Text: (at least don't hide it at the end)

pointers.Original Text: （うむ。それは至極良いアイデアだ。ならばここから先はキングの俺に任せなさい！）
pointers.New Text:
(Hmm. That's an excellent idea!
From here on out, leave it to
King me!)
pointers.MT Text:
(Hmm. That's an excellent idea!
From here on out, leave it to
King me!)

pointers.Original Text: 「お集まり頂いた姫には誠に申し訳ないのですが、今日はこれにてホスト部の営業を閉めさせて頂きたい」
pointers.New Text:
I'm truly sorry to my princess,
but I'd like to close the Host
Club for today.
pointers.MT Text:
I'm truly sorry to my princess,
but I'd like to close the Host
Club for today.

pointers.Original Text: 「姫君の熱い吐息、熱い眼差しを一身に受ける有り難くうるわしい時を中断するのは断腸の思いではありますが」
pointers.New Text:
It pains me to interrupt this
blessed moment, but
pointers.MT Text:
It pains me to interrupt this
blessed moment, but

Indeed, one bite should be

Your plan was a complete
failure.

Lord's plan was a total failure,

Wasn't it good because you were
more normal than usual?

Wasn't it better this time since you
were more normal?

Ugh! Didn't our plan also fall
apart easily?

Ugh! Didn't your plan fall apart
just as easily?

Yeah, but I'm not speaking
passionately like you.

Yeah, but I'm not speaking
passionately like you.

That's right. We don't speak
passionately like lords.

Yeah, that's right. We don't talk as
passionately as you guys do.

I can't act all high and mighty
when I'm failing.
pointers.MT Text:
I can't act all high and mighty
when I'm failing.

Mommy, Mommy! Hikaru and Kaoru
are bullying Dad!
pointers.MT Text:
Mommy, Mommy! Hikaru and Kaoru
are bullying Dad!

pointers.Original Text: 「何度も言っているがこの年で子持ち設定なのか、俺は」

I'm not some guy with a kid at
my age, no matter how many times
you say it.

I keep telling you, I'm not some old
guy with a kid, okay?

pointers.Original Text: 「余計に混乱を招くので環先輩は静かにしていて下さい」

Your presence only confuses
things more, so please stay
quiet, Tamaki-senpai.

Senpai, your mouth just confuses
things more, so please shut up.

pointers.Original Text: 「うわあああん！　今度は娘までお父さんを～……」

Ahhhhh! Now my daughter too...
daddy...

AAAAHH! Now even my daughter's after
dad~~...

pointers.Original Text: 「光と馨はどんな意見があるの？」

What do you guys think, Hikaru and
Kaoru?

The twins wave everyone but
Honey-senpai over.
pointers.MT Text:
The twins wave everyone but
Honey-senpai over.

So basically, you don't like
carrots?

So basically, you don't like
carrots, right?

Just feed her lots of carrots
then.

Then just feed her a ton of
carrots, right?

If you say it like a prince,
even 'no' can sound like 'yes.'
pointers.MT Text:
Even if you say it like a master, I
guess I'm used to it by now.

pointers.Original Text: 「食べまくってれば耐性がつくんじゃない？」

Eat a lot and you'll build up a
tolerance, right?

Isn't resistance built up if I just
keep eating it?

pointers.Original Text: 「……との意見ですがどう思います？」
pointers.New Text: What do you think about that?

pointers.Original Text: 「苦手なものを克服するにはそれ自体を食べさせるという至極安易な方法ではあるな」

It's an extremely easy way to
overcome your weakness by
forcing yourself to eat it.
pointers.MT Text:
It's a pretty lazy way to overcome
your fears by just eating them.

Who here is brave enough to
force carrot down Honey-senpai's
throat?
pointers.MT Text:
Who here is brave enough to
force carrot down Honey-senpai's
throat?

pointers.Original Text: 「唯一なんとか出来そうな人物としてモリ先輩があげられるが……」

Mori-senpai is the only person
who might be able to do it...
pointers.MT Text:
Mori-senpai is the only person who
might be able to do something about
it... but...

pointers.Original Text: 「光邦が本気で嫌がることは出来ない」
「とまあ、一時期ハニー先輩にお菓子断ちを決行してマリアナ海溝よりも深く落ち込んだモリ先輩だ」
pointers.New Text:
I once went on a sweets strike
because of Honey and hit rock
bottom.
pointers.MT Text:
I once went on a sweets strike
because of Honey and hit rock
bottom.

pointers.Original Text: 「お菓子断ちよりもハードルの高いこの問題を任せるのは荷が重いだろう」

Leaving this problem to you

giving up sweets.

Leaving this problem to you is a
bigger ask than just giving up
sweets.

pointers.Original Text: ハニー先輩は機嫌が悪いと素で顔つきと、口調が悪くなる。

When Honey-senpai's in a bad
mood, his face and tone really
do get mean.
pointers.MT Text:
When Honey-senpai's in a bad
mood, his face and tone really
do get mean.

pointers.Original Text: 普段とのギャップが激しすぎて対処のしようがないんだよね。

There's just no telling what
he'll do next.

The gap between his everyday self
and this is just too big to handle.

pointers.Original Text: 「ぬう。確かに嫌いなものを無理矢理食べさせられれば、メガトン級に機嫌の悪いハニー先輩が覚醒するのも必須」

Force her to eat carrots and
Honey-senpai will enter
mega-tantrum mode.

Force her to eat carrots and
Honey-senpai will enter
mega-tantrum mode.

pointers.Original Text: 「元はと言えばお前達の提案だろう！　それを途中で……」

It was your idea in the first
place! You're the ones who...
pointers.MT Text:
It was your idea in the first place!
And you just dropped it halfway
through...

pointers.Original Text: 「だーって、機嫌の悪いハニー先輩なんかみても僕らに得ないし」
pointers.New Text:
I mean, there's nothing in it
for us to see an angry
Honey-senpai.
pointers.MT Text:
I mean, there's nothing in it
for us to see an angry
Honey-senpai.

pointers.Original Text: 「ねー、なんか飽きちゃった。別に好き嫌いがあってもいいんじゃない」
pointers.New Text:
Hey, I'm getting bored. It's
fine to have likes and dislikes.
pointers.MT Text:
Hey, I'm getting bored of it. It's
okay to have things you don't like,
right?

pointers.Original Text: 「見事なまでに自分勝手ですね」

pointers.New Text:
Well, think about it. Likes and
dislikes are what make things
interesting.
pointers.MT Text:
Come on, think about it, likes and
dislikes are what make things
worthwhile.

pointers.Original Text: 「そうそう。好きなものだけ食べてればいいんだからさ。嫌いなものなんてデリートデリート」
pointers.New Text:
Just that. You only eat what you
like. Delete delete the stuff
you don't.
pointers.MT Text:
Yeah, that's right. Just eat what
you like and forget about the stuff
you don't.

pointers.Original Text: 「はあ……。光と馨に聞いた自分が馬鹿だったかも」
pointers.New Text:
Sigh... Maybe I was the idiot
for asking Hikaru and Kaoru.
pointers.MT Text:
Sigh... Maybe I was the idiot
for asking Hikaru and Kaoru.

Listening to that isn't good for

Hey Haruhi, you shouldn't do stuff

That's right. We worked hard
thinking about it~
pointers.MT Text:
Yeah, yeah. We worked really hard on
it, you know?

pointers.MT Text:
Um, nobody else has any other ideas,
right?

My special idea failed too. Do

I failed with my special idea too,

I regret to say that I thought

I regret to say that I thought
the same as Tama-chan.

I don't want to!! My princess,

Unfair!! Haruhi~ hearing that makes

Close, close. Our faces are so

Sir~. Don't take the harassment

Master~. Don't take the sexual

Come over here, Haruhi. It's

Haruhi, you're in danger over

Boys' pee is unsightly, Your

Hmm~ Can't do that. Can't

But... we can't overcome it

I'm going to go train! I'll do

something different!

I don't think that will solve

I don't think that'll solve

Once Mitsukuni's like that, he

I'm eating with plenty of room
